summary: OpenID is widely used for web single sign-on, while SASL and GSS-API are frameworks that applications use for authentication. This RFC defines a mechanism for both so existing OpenID Identity Providers can be used by applications that speak SASL or GSS-API.

eli5.summary: You already have a library card from one place. This lets other clubs accept that card instead of making you a new one.
